grid.layout_notes: Official rowsReels 2-3-3-3-2. Outlaw Wilds are 3-row-high on reels 2-4.

other.name: Outlaw Wilds (xNudge)
other.how_it_works: 3-row-high Wild on reels 2-4; always nudges fully visible; +1 win mult per nudge step. Substitutes except Scatter and Badge.

wilds.name: Outlaw Wild (xNudge)
wilds.behavior: 3-high on reels 2-4; nudge +1 mult/step. Sticky in Justice/Bounty; unlimited sticky mult in Gunslinger.

scatters.name: Scatter
scatters.behavior: 3 Scatters → 10 Gunslinger Spins. During FS: 1 Scatter +1 spin, 2 Scatters +3 spins.

scatters.name: Sheriff Badge / Marshall Badge
scatters.behavior: Sheriff on reel 1 + Marshall on reel 5 → 3 Justice Spins. Both badges + 3 Scatters → 12 Bounty Spins.

multipliers.name: Outlaw Wild nudge multiplier
multipliers.behavior: Increases by 1 per nudge; unlimited and sticky for entire Gunslinger/Bounty feature.

base_game_loop.summary: Ways spin on 2-3-3-3-2 (108). Outlaw xNudge Wilds on middle three (+1 mult/nudge). Optional xBet 2× guarantees Scatter or Outlaw Wild (~2× FS chance). Sheriff+Marshall → 3 Justice (sticky Wilds); 3 Scatters → 10 Gunslinger (sticky unlimited mult); badges+3 Scatters → 12 Bounty. Buys 65–2,310×.

phases.name: Configure xBet
phases.what_happens: Optional xBet at 2× base: guarantee Scatter or Outlaw Wild; ~2× freespin chance. Pays unaffected.

phases.name: Spin + nudge
phases.what_happens: Reels stop; Outlaw Wilds nudge fully visible adding win mult.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: Sheriff+Marshall → Justice 3; 3 Scatters → Gunslinger 10; badges+3 Scatters → Bounty 12.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways after nudges with Outlaw Wild multipliers.
base_game_loop.notes: CMS on nolimitcity.com/games/tombstone-no-mercy. Second xBet (Outlaw Wild-only) has empty CMS description.

modes.name: Justice Spins
modes.trigger: Sheriff Badge on reel 1 and Marshall Badge on reel 5.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Outlaw Wilds stick throughout Justice Spins.
modes.progressive_state: Nudge mult +1 per step on sticky Wilds.

modes.name: Gunslinger Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Unlimited win multiplier from Outlaw Wild nudges sticks for entire feature.
modes.progressive_state: +1 mult per Outlaw nudge step across the bonus.

phases.name: Enter Gunslinger
phases.what_happens: 10 spins; sticky unlimited Outlaw win mult.

modes.effects: 10 FS; sticky unlimited nudge mult; scatter retriggers.

modes.name: Bounty Spins
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Outlaw Wilds stick once landed; nudge mult for each step (Gunslinger+Justice combo).

phases.name: Enter Bounty
phases.what_happens: 12 spins combining sticky Wilds and sticky unlimited nudge mult.

modes.effects: 12 FS; sticky Wilds + sticky nudge mult; scatter retriggers.
